author: Karl Rock
description:
Are these consoles real or fake? I found a mix of counterfeit and genuine retro gaming consoles at a thieves market in Pakistan!

From a fake PlayStation called the Polystation to a dusty original PlayStation, a fake Game Boy, a knockoff PSP called the PvP Pocket Light, a PlayStation 2 and a Sega Mega Drive, this market had some interesting gaming finds. I even spotted a PS3 game!

Would you buy any of these retro gaming consoles? Which one brings back the most memories?
title: Thieves Market Gaming Finds
